verdict.rationale: Skyfire ties every transaction to an identified buyer/seller agent via scoped API keys and KYA/pay tokens, and notes that 'from the merchant's side, an agentic purchase is never anonymous,' meaning attribution data exists per charge (skyfire-docs-1, skyfire-supp-7, skyfire-supp-8). However, there is no documented merchant-facing reporting or dashboard filter that lets sellers query/filter past transactions specifically by agent identity — only agent-scoped token creation and charging APIs are shown. Missing for 10: a documented transactions/reporting dashboard or API endpoint for filtering/aggregating charges by agent, and any analytics/export feature for merchants.
